			      }
		    }

             return str;
         var result = str;
         for (var v in $bs_vars) {
             var regex = new RegExp('\\$\\{' + v.toString() + '\\}|\\{' + v.toString() + '\\}', 'igm');

<script type="text/javascript">
    var makeUserInfo = function (resp) {
        var userInfo = {};
        //userInfo.name = resp.Model.Email;
        userInfo.isLogin = resp.Success;
        return userInfo;
    }

    $.ajax({
        url: '/User/Account/GetUserLoginInfo?v=' + Math.random()
        , data: {}
        , cache: false
        , type: 'post'
        , success: function (resp) {
            //配置用户基本信息
            var userInfo = makeUserInfo(resp);
            var loginView = $(".login-hearder .isLogin");
            var unLoginView = $(".login-hearder .unLogin");
            if (userInfo.isLogin) {
                loginView.show()
            }
            else {
                unLoginView.show()
            }

        }//success
        , error: function () {
            throw new Error('ERROR: get user info')
        }
    });//ajax
</script>
<script>
   // 初始化来也机器人
    function initLaiye(){
        var aiScript = document.createElement('script');
        aiScript.type = 'text/javascript';
        aiScript.src = 'https://cdn.wul.ai/IMLib-3.30.0.min.js';
        document.body.insertBefore(aiScript, document.body.firstChild);
        aiScript.onload = function () {
            // 需要在这里写ajax异步操作，不然它可能在没加载之前调用然后报错
            $.ajax({
                url: '/User/Account/GetWulPubKey'
                , type: 'get'
                , success: function (resp) {
                    // 获取来也机器人信息
                    var isOpen = resp.Data.IsOpen;
                    if (isOpen) {
                        var key = resp.Data.PubKey;
                        new websdk({
                            data: {
                                pubkey: key, // 吾来平台PubKey
                                autoOpen: false, // 是否自动打开
                                extra: {
                                    tagValues: [],
                                    presetTagValues: []
                                }
                            },
                            el: 'body'
                        })
                    }
                }
            })
        }
    }
    
    // 初始化天润机器
    function initTianrun(robotKey){
        (function(win, doc, src, opt) {
            win[opt] = win[opt] || function () {
            win[opt].options = arguments[0]};
            var script = doc.createElement("script");
            script.async = 1;
            script.src = src;
            doc.body.appendChild(script);
            })(window, document, "https://webchat-sh.clink.cn/webchat.js?v="+Date.now(), "clinkWebchatOptions");
        clinkWebchatOptions({
            accessId: robotKey,
            language: "zh_CN"
        });
    }

    // 获取天润机器人灰度
    $.ajax({
            url: '/User/Account/GetPortalAIRobot'
            , type: 'get'
            , success: function (resp) {
                if (resp.Data.IsOpen && resp.Data.PubKey) {
                    initTianrun(resp.Data.PubKey)
                }else{
                    initLaiye();
                }
            }
        })
</script>

<script language="javascript">
    var htmlSuccess = ['<div class="dl_dialog1">',
                        '   <div class="dl_dialog_wrap" style="text-align:center">',
                        '       <div class="dl_dialog_icook"><span>收藏成功！</span></div>',
                        //' <div class="dl_dialog_btn">',
                        //' <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="dl_btn_grey1" id="okbtn1" ><span>确定</span></a>',
                        //'     <div>',
                        '   </div>',
                        '</div>'].join("");
    var htmlError = ['<div class="dl_dialog1">',
                        '   <div class="dl_dialog_wrap" style="text-align:center">',
                        '       <div class="dl_dialog_icowarn"><span>收藏失败！</span></div>',
                        '   <div class="dl_dialog_btn">',
                        ' <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="dl_btn_grey1" id="okbtn1" ><span>确定</span></a>',
                        '       <div>',
                        '   </div>',
                        '</div>'].join("");

    $.ajax({
        url: '/User/Account/GetUserLoginInfo?v=' + Math.random()
        , data: {
            'jobAdId': "311047199"
        }
        , type: 'post'
        , error: function () { }
        , success: function (resp) {

            var args = resp.Model;

            var hasA = args.HasApplyedFoJs;
            var isAllow = args.Allow;
            var allowCount = args.AllowCount;
            var jobCategory = "校园招聘";
            var isLogin = resp.Success;
            var isAllowApplyInfinity = args.IntAllowApplyInfinity;
            var jobAdCategory = args.JobAdCategory || 1; // 1 社招 2 校招 3 实习生
            var JOB_CATEGORY_ARRAY = [,'社招', '校招', '实习生'];
            //var jobAdCategoryName = JOB_CATEGORY_ARRAY[jobAdCategory];
            var jobAdCategoryName = args.JobAdCategoryName || ''
            var jobApplyMaxLimit = args.MaxAllowCount;

            $(document).ready(function () {
                // 申请状态
                $(".boxSupertitle .applyStatus").css("font-weight", "normal")
                if (hasA == 0) {
                    $(".boxSupertitle .applyStatus").text("(未申请)")
                } else {
                    $(".boxSupertitle .applyStatus").text("(已申请)")
                }
                //根据用户的登陆状态给收藏按钮绑定事件
                var collectBtn = $("#collect");
                if (isLogin) {

                    collectBtn
                        .unbind('click')
                        .bind('click', function () {
                            $.post("/Portal/Apply/JobAdCollect", { "jId": "311047199" }, function (data) {
                                if (!data) {
                                    htmlSuccess = htmlError;
                                }
                                $.modal(htmlSuccess, {
                                    containerCss: {
                                        backgroundColor: "transparent",
                                        borderColor: "transparent",
                                        padding: 0,
                                        width: '150px'
                                    },
                                    onShow: function () {
                                        $("#okbtn1").click(function () {
                                            $.modal.close();
                                        });
                                    }
                                });
                                function a() {
                                    $.modal.close();
                                }
                                setTimeout(a, 2000);
                            }, "json");
                        });
                }
                else {
                    collectBtn
                        .unbind('click')
                        .bind('click', function () {
                            location.href = '/Portal/Account/Login' + '?returnUrl=' + location.href;
                        });
                }

                $("#apply").click(function () {
                    if (!isLogin) {
                        location.href = '/Portal/Account/Login' + '?returnUrl=' + location.href;
                        return;
                    }
                    var isRecommendJob = false;
                    var jobAdId = 311047199;
                    var jobAdName = "仿真推演开发工程师(J11991)";

                    function goNext() {
                        function jump() {
                            var url = $("#apply").attr("url");
                            window.location.href = url;
                            $.modal.close();
                            showWaitDialage("页面跳转中......");
                        }

                        // 判断调用内推码弹窗-20210115
                        isRecommendJob ? RecommendCodeMadal.confirm({ jobName: jobAdName, jobId: jobAdId }, jump) : jump();
                    }

                    if (allowCount == 0 && hasA == 0) {

                        var maxhas = ['<div class="dl_dialog1">',
                                        '    <div class="dl_dialog_wrap">',
                                        '       <div class="dl_dialog_icowarn"><span>您申请的', jobAdCategoryName, '职位个数已达上限（最多', jobApplyMaxLimit, '个），无法继续投递</span></div>',
                                        '    <div class="dl_dialog_btn">',
                                        ' <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="dl_btn_grey1 ok" id="okbtn2"><span>确定</span></a>',
                                        '        <div>',
                                        '    </div>',
                                        '</div>'].join("");
                        $.modal(maxhas, {
                            containerCss: {
                                backgroundColor: "transparent",
                                borderColor: "transparent",
                                padding: 0,
                                width: '360px'
                            },
                            onShow: function () {
                                $("#okbtn2").on("click", function () {
                                    $.modal.close();
                                });
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    else if (hasA == 1 && isAllow == 0) {
                        var hasas = ['<div class="dl_dialog1">',
                                        '    <div class="dl_dialog_wrap">',
                                        '       <div class="dl_dialog_icowarn"><span>您之前已经成功申请过该职位，请不要重复申请！</span></div>',
                                        '    <div class="dl_dialog_btn">',
                                        ' <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="dl_btn_grey1 ok" id="okbtn2"><span>确定</span></a>',
                                        '        <div>',
                                        '    </div>',
                                        '</div>'].join("");
                        $.modal(hasas, {
                            containerCss: {
                                backgroundColor: "transparent",
                                borderColor: "transparent",
                                padding: 0,
                                width: '360px'
                            },
                            onShow: function () {
                                $("#okbtn2").on("click", function () {
                                    $.modal.close();
                                });
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    else {
                        if (hasA == 1 || isAllowApplyInfinity == 1) {
                            goNext();
                            return;
                        }

                        var applyMsg = ["您可申请", jobApplyMaxLimit, "个", jobAdCategoryName, "职位，还剩", allowCount, "个，是否继续投递"].join("");

                        var maxhas = ['<div class="dl_dialog1">',
                                        '    <div class="dl_dialog_wrap">',
                                        '       <div class="dl_dialog_icowarn"><span>' + applyMsg + '</span></div>',
                                        '    <div class="dl_dialog_btn">',
                                        ' <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="dl_btn_grey1 ok" id="okbtn2"><span>确定</span></a>',
                                        ' <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="dl_btn_grey1 ok" id="cancelBtn"><span>取消</span></a>',
                                        '        <div>',
                                        '    </div>',
                                        '</div>'].join("");
                        $.modal(maxhas, {
                            containerCss: {
                                backgroundColor: "transparent",
                                borderColor: "transparent",
                                padding: 0,
                                width: '360px'
                            },
                            onShow: function () {
                                $("#okbtn2").on("click", function () {
                                    goNext();
                                });

                                $("#cancelBtn").on("click", function () {
                                    $.modal.close();
                                });
                            }
                        });
                    }

                })
            })

        }
    });

    function ReturnToJobList() {
        if (document.referrer == null || document.referrer == "" || document.referrer == location.href) {
            location.href = '/';
        }
        else {
            location.href = document.referrer;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function showWaitDialage(msg) {
        var html = ['<div class="dl_dialog1">',
                ' <div class="dl_dialog_wrap">',
                '   <div class="dl_tocenter">',
                '<span class=" dl_ft14_grey2"><b>' + msg + '</b>',
                '</span>',
                '</div>',
                ' </div>',
                '</div>'].join("");

        $.modal(html, {
            containerCss: {
                backgroundColor: "transparent",
                borderColor: "transparent",
                padding: 0
            },
            onShow: function () {
                $("div[class='dl_dialog1']").css("padding", "15px");
            }
        });
    }

</script>
